in_marathi.name: Ishaavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishaavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishaavi is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'Goddess of Love'. In Hindu mythology, Ishavasya Upanishad refers to a Goddess named Ishani, who is considered the goddess of love and compassion. This name is believed to bring blessings of love, devotion, and purity in life.
